# Logistics 0.2.1-alpha.1

- On desktop, download selected remote files and folders from the transfer view.
- On iOS, playback has simpler controls and more reliable seeking when using AirPlay. Apple TV playback exposes the available media tracks.
- Mobile Settings groups cleanup actions by what they remove. Desktop Settings now lets you delete saved Notes Library playlists.
- The user guides are shorter and organized around common tasks. The developer guides point to the code and checks for each feature.
- Mobile test runs avoid duplicate smoke checks, and the build tooling retains timing reports alongside test results for troubleshooting.

Please try rewinding and resuming a video on Apple TV, downloading a selection that includes folders, and finding the instructions for a task you use often. Include the device, OS, app build, and steps when reporting an issue.
